name: InterStoreTransferManager
tagline: Move stock between stores and know it arrived – requests, approvals, picks, dispatch, receipts and discrepancies in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete store-to-store transfer app for retail chains, hotel groups and restaurant groups: requests with reason, priority and needed-by date, approval with value limits and a safety-stock keep-back, pick lists with short-pick reasons, dispatch with a carrier / manifest reference, in-transit SLA, receipt with shortages, damages and over-receipts, discrepancy resolution with write-off limits, an inbound / outbound view per store, a drag-and-drop pipeline, store balance and lane matrix. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped and connects to any data source in a few clicks.
features: Transfer requests with reason, priority and needed-by date
Store rules: the sending store approves and ships, the receiving store receives
Approval limit for the area manager
Source keep-back (safety stock) protection with override
Receipt with shortages, damages and over-receipts
Role rules (associate, store manager, area manager)
Drill-down, bulk close / reject, undo, CSV export
Power Fx outputs and events (TransferNoteText, SummaryJson)
